areas.s: Posture, braking, first step, max velocity
Land first, then hop, jump, bound

cells: Stance & braking. Athletic stance, quiet 3-step stops, split step, reaction to Dad's signal. Chase games with Dad stationary.
Posture indoors. Wall drill (6–8 reps, never 20), fast feet, hallway reaction starts.
Acceleration. Falling starts, 5–10m bursts, band-resisted starts, first-step games. Dad starts running.
Max velocity. 20–30m flys, hill sprints (4–6), timed gates, PR chasing. Peak speed block.
Speed under chaos. Tag variants, ball chase, sprint-then-hit, multi-directional starts.
Free speed. Races on grass and sand, bike sprints, final retest.
Landing. Stick landings from ground, curb, 30cm box. Single-leg stick. "Silent landing" scoring.
Rhythm hops. Jump rope streaks, pogo hops, low hops. No max jumps during the move window.
Bilateral power. Broad jumps, low box jumps, med ball slams.
Plyo & hills. Hill jumps and backpedals, bounding, mini-hurdle hops, single-leg hops.
Reactive power. Jump-and-catch, rebound jumps, sport jumps (rebounds, headers).
Play power. Pool jumps, long-jump pit, trampoline if available.
Cartwheel steps 1–3. Bunny hops over a line, hand-hand-foot-foot, lunge entry. Donkey kicks. 30s single-leg balance. Skateboard.
Cartwheel steps 4–5. Straight legs, from standing. Forward and backward rolls. Wall handstand holds. Rope singles to 30.
Footwork. Agility ladder, crossover steps, jump rope tricks, cartwheel both sides.
Rhythm & bounding. Skips, gallops, carioca, A-skips, B-skips.
Agility with decision. Cone drills on Dad's call, mirror drills, sport footwork.
Adventure balance. Skateboard, bike skills, log walks, slackline, water.
Hang & crawl. Dead hangs, Riverside traveling rings intro, animal walk medleys.
Pull & hold. Rings passes to 5 and back, hanging knee raises, monkey bars. Hollow holds, crab and bear walks.
Rotate & carry. Med ball rotations, suitcase carries, push-up progressions, climbing.
Elastic strength. Hill backpedals, single-leg work, balance-board squats and lunges with tennis ball.
Durability. Maintain. Circuits, partner pushing and pulling games.
Climb & swim. Playground, trees and rocks where safe, swimming as strength.
Step & throw. Opposite foot forward, both arms, at a wall target.
Hip turn. Add trunk rotation, med ball hip throws, non-dominant volume.
Full sequence. Step, hip, shoulder, arm. Distance and accuracy games.
Overhead. Overhead throwing into the serve pattern. Catching under pressure: pop-ups, off the bounce.
Accuracy. Throwing competitions, lacrosse and basketball application, one-hand catches.
Sampling. Baseball catch, frisbee, water tosses.

Form Unit turn, contact in front, finish over the shoulder. Shadow swings, side feeds, drop feeds.Footwork Ready position, split step on Dad's clap, shuffle recovery.Ball Current ball. Wall rally.Match Cooperative rally counting.

Form Both wings equal volume. Med ball FH/BH rotation. One- vs two-hand backhand settled.Footwork Adjust steps and recovery shuffle without a ball; hallway patterns.Ball Wall rally with the next ball up.Match Mini-tennis points.

Form Open-stance forehand. Consistent low-to-high path.Footwork Crossover recovery, first step to the ball.Ball Cooperative rally on the next ball, depth targets, 20-ball rallies.Match Directional control: cross-court, down the line.
Form Serve from the overhead throw. Volley: charge, split, catch.Footwork Approach footwork, split step before the volley.Ball Gate check.Match Serve + 1. Attack the short ball.

Form Form under pace: Dad feeds harder.Footwork Recovery at match tempo.Ball Gate check; controlled yellow exposure if cleared.Match Point construction, scoring, tiebreaks, tournament vs Dad. Cross-court default, attack short, serve + 1.
Form Maintain.Ball Whatever the gates allow.Match Fun matches, local kids, retest rally counts.
Dad stationary. Wall ball, HORSE, roll-out sharks and minnows, tag with a base.
Indoor games. Rings and skate park stay in the rotation through the move. Holiday weeks light.
Winter games. Basketball, indoor tennis, first chase games with Dad.
Races. Timed challenges. Handicap vs Dad narrows.
Tournaments. Head-to-head vs Dad. Tennis matches.
Free play. Bike adventures, pool, minimal structure.
patches: Quiet 3-step stop from a jog, 5 in a row. Split step on 10 of 10 signals.
10 silent stick landings in a row from a 30cm box. A broad jump you also stick.
Cartwheel over a line, hands and feet on the line (form first, straight legs later). 30s single-leg balance each leg.
20s dead hang. 5 traveling-rings passes with a spot, or 20m bear walk without knees touching.
Step-and-throw with the opposite foot, 10 of 10, both arms.
15-ball cooperative rally. Forehand and backhand from a drop feed with unit turn and finish over the shoulder, 8 of 10.
Complete 6 of 8 Challenge-of-the-Week checks and show up to Trials.
gates: Hand feeds, short court and wall only. Requires: 20-ball green rally on the full court; handles the green high bounce with spacing on 8 of 10; serve in 6 of 10; hits a cross-court pattern on request. Checked every Trials week.
Held until controlled exposure has been clean for a full block and his coach agrees. Even then, green stays the default rally ball for form work. Reassess Sep 2027.
battery: Standing start, 2–3 trials, full rest, phone timer. Best.
3 trials. Must stick the landing to count. Measure to the back heel.
2 trials each leg. Stick on the same leg. A gap over 15% is a flag.
Tennis ball, 3 throws each arm. Best each.
5m out, touch, back, touch, out. 2 trials. Best.
Consecutive without a miss. Best of 3.
Cooperative rally with Dad, current ball. Best of 3.
roles: Tumbling homework, landing, throwing. Low impact after gym.
Rings, hangs, strength, coordination, med ball.
The one high-impact home day. Speed, power, games.
Tennis wall and court, throwing, skill, ball games.
Skate park, balance, weekly challenge, free play. Low impact before Saturday.
Quick card, patch check, week review.
northStar: Compete at the highest levels of tennis at 20. Not precocious at 8.
